apps.name: RagaMentor
apps.versionDescription: v1.5.39 — The song list now sorts by last updated: edit a song’s loops, groups, phrases, notes, title or raga and it rises to the top. Just playing a song does not move it. Songs you have not edited yet keep their added order until their first edit.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
